name: ultrareview-slice
description: Review a whole codebase with /code-review ultra, past its 500-file / 8,000-line cap: partition the repo into slices (each module with its tests), one worktree per slice, launch them in parallel, and collect the findings or --fix edits onto one branch. Or run the same slices as claude --cloud review sessions on cloud-session credit, with JSONL findings pushed to branches and fetched back.
